Marcie Loves Alameda
## Meet Marcie
Marcie is running for Alameda City Council to represent, advocate for, and serve the residents of Alameda in ways that will ensure the continuation of Alameda as a destination to live, work, and visit. Marcie previously served the City of Alameda as its Social Services Manager, stewarding provider contracts and coalitions. Marcie currently serves on the Alameda County Health Care for the Homeless Commission and their Community/Consumer Advocate Board. As a City Council Member, Marcie will work hard and reasonably to contribute to decision-making on behalf of Alamedans to prepare Alameda for the many challenges ahead.

# Supporter of Marcie Johnson
We're garnering community support for our campaign.
Stewart Chen
I'm supporting Marcie Soslau Johnson for Alameda City Council because her experience in the city government gives her a strong, practical perspective on how to get things done. I find her honest, straightforward, and committed to serving the community.
Phong La
Marcie has my endorsement as an Alamedan who will do what it takes, collaborate, and make tough decisions thoughtfully in a way that will represent the diverse communities that make up our island home.
Betty Yee
I am pleased to endorse Marcie Johnson for Alameda City Council. Her track record over more than two decades of community service with accountable oversight will be an asset for Alameda as difficult decisions about our physical and financial future demand heightened focus. Please join me in supporting Marcie Johnson, a responsible, compassionate leader for Alameda.
Lena Tam
I am supporting Marcie Johnson for city council because of her commitment to our city through her partnerships with city staff and community stakeholders in advancing the priorities that matter to our residents. I appreciate Marcie's willingness to serve and I look forward to continuing to work with Marcie to strengthen our community and build a better future for the City of Alameda.
Alice Lai-Bitker
Marcie knocked on my door in April, ready to walk and engage. Marcie knows how to listen and wants to learn. I am supporting Marcie because I know she has the persistence and strength to do what it takes, to represent us as a council member.
